title: Local Vibe Coding
tagline: Make a web app from a Mad Libs prompt.

steps.title: Fill in your prompt
steps.hint: Invent four answers or roll dice and use the options sheet, then send your sentence.
steps.done_when: The participant sent a prompt with a kind of app, topic, audience, and visual style instead of literal blanks.

steps.title: Build and try your app
steps.hint: Ask Pi to make your app, open the local URL, and try its interaction.
steps.done_when: index.html contains a self-contained interactive app served at localhost, and the participant confirms they tried its interaction.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.hint: Ask Pi for one change, then try the updated app.
steps.done_when: Pi made a participant-requested change to index.html and the participant confirms they tried the updated app.
